title: Spyglass Officially Launched
summary: We are thrilled to announce the official launch of Spyglass, delivering powerful new insights to elevate your experience.

title: Enhanced File Control in Your Editor
summary: We've introduced powerful new tools that give you complete control over your files within the editor, allowing you to easily manage, upload, and present your content exactly as you envision.

title: Unlock Our Vision: Explore the New Product Roadmap
summary: We're thrilled to unveil our new public roadmap, offering you a clear and dynamic view of our development progress, from recent achievements to future innovations.

title: Revamped Checkboxes for Effortless Task Management
summary: Experience a smoother workflow with our newly redesigned checkboxes, now bigger, easier to click, and effortlessly draggable to help you organize and manage tasks more efficiently.

title: Improved Collaboration Experience
summary: We've upgraded the overall collaboration experience to bring more awareness and ease to working with your team.

title: Unlock Shared Insights with Friends
summary: Effortlessly discover and collaborate on shared content, strengthening your connections and boosting your productivity.

title: Noeko Goes Global: New Languages Arriving!
summary: Get ready to experience Noeko in your preferred language as we roll out support for a wide array of international languages.

title: Noeko Goes Open Source
summary: Noeko is embracing open source to empower our community with greater transparency, control, and direct participation in shaping its future.

title: Dynamic Constellation Insights
summary: Explore and organize your knowledge base with unparalleled ease using the updated Constellation view, which now offers powerful filtering by tags and time, plus clear visibility into your shared content.

title: Advanced Search & Dynamic Collections
summary: Navigate your knowledge with unprecedented precision using powerful new filters and sorting options, then instantly save your customized views as dynamic collections for easy retrieval.

title: Dynamic Content Views
summary: Seamlessly visualize your connected thoughts with new, flexible ways to display and interact with linked information, mirroring your natural thought process.

title: Unlock Noeko with Flexible Plans and Self-Hosting
summary: We're thrilled to introduce flexible new plans for Noeko, empowering you with robust self-hosting options and tailored solutions for every need.

title: Beautiful New Themes & Refreshed Classics
summary: Get ready for an expanded library of visually appealing themes, along with significant improvements to our current selections, to perfectly match your aesthetic.

title: Smarter Homepage Greetings
summary: Enjoy a more precise and welcoming experience as your homepage greeting now perfectly aligns with the current time of day.

title: Streamlined Tag Organization
summary: This new feature empowers you to quickly remove items from tags, delete, and even view them directly from any tag's list, significantly streamlining your organizational workflow.

title: Unlock a Universe of Knowledge with Expanded Content Sources
summary: We're dramatically expanding the types of content you can bring into our platform, allowing you to seamlessly integrate valuable insights from YouTube videos, websites, and text files to build your unified knowledge base.
